announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: OCTAGON HEALTHCARE FUNDING PLC has published its Half-year Financial Report. This follows the Restoration of Listing in August 2026.

announcements.headline: Restoration of Listing
announcements.insight: OCTAGON HEALTHCARE FUNDING PLC restores its listing following the July bondholder presentation. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent regulatory filings detailing the process.

announcements.headline: Notification of Bondholder Presentation
announcements.insight: Bondholders are being presented with information. Shareholders should watch for subsequent filings detailing any decisions or outcomes from this meeting.
